title: Role of Heat Treatment Atmosphere on the Microstructure and Surface Morphology of DLP-Fabricated High-Entropy Alloy Components.

recollection.starting_material: Guess: DLP-fabricated high-entropy alloy (HEA) components, likely as-printed samples
recollection.intervention: Guess: Heat treatment under different atmospheres (e.g., air, argon, vacuum)
recollection.structure: Guess: Changes in microstructure such as grain size, phase distribution, and surface morphology due to atmosphere
recollection.mechanism: Guess: Atmosphere affects oxidation, diffusion, and phase stability during heat treatment, leading to different microstructural outcomes
recollection.results: Guess: Quantitative results likely include grain size measurements, surface roughness, and possibly hardness or mechanical properties, showing significant dependence on atmosphere used during heat treatment
